commands.summary: Plan Create an Account through a named Chatwoot reverse ETL action.
commands.risk: Chatwoot platform API mutation (POST /platform/api/v1/accounts); reverse ETL plan, preview, explicit approval, and execute are required; admin/elevated mutation is typed-confirmation gated
commands.approval: Plan first, inspect preview output, then execute only with the generated approval token and --confirm destructive.
examples: pm chatwoot operations create account --credential chatwoot-prod --preview --json
